subject: Mobile Development
title: The App Store Tax Debate
description: A quick win: understand The App Store Tax Debate.

hook.text: Apple and Google take up to 30% of every dollar earned through their app stores.

buildup.text: Developers argue the commission is too high, especially for digital goods and subscriptions.

discovery.text: Both platforms reduced the cut to 15% for small developers earning under $1 million per year.

twist.text: Large developers like Spotify and Epic say 15% is still too much for just processing payments.

climax.text: The app store tax debate is reshaping regulations worldwide and may break open the duopoly.

punchline.text: Thirty percent is a tax, not a fee, say developers.

quiz.question: What is the reduced app store commission for small developers?
